name: fleet_haiku_deep_value
strategy: Risk-adjusted momentum mean-reversion via sector rotation: short exhausted tech momentum (TQQQ), rotate into small-cap value and energy with reduced BTC leverage ahead of rate hike.
reassessment_note: Reducing BTC perp leverage from 2x to 1x to protect +45% gains and manage risk ahead of expected rate hike. Market has priced in 25bp move at 78-88% odds. Small-cap value (IWD, KRE) and energy (XLE +11.51%) rotation thesis remains intact and well-positioned for higher-rate environment. Same-direction overlap with Round 2 is <10%, maintaining strategy differentiation.

positions.thesis: Tactical long: broad market exposure at reduced weight to complement sector-specific bets.
Small-cap domestic value: lowest valuation tier, 1.60% YTD gain demonstrates mean-reversion into quality small-cap names; higher rates support quality value.
Energy sector capitulation play: +11.51% YTD outperformance driven by Iran geopolitical premium and supply disruption signals; higher rates favor commodity-linked sectors.
Financials sector: rate hike tail-wind for net interest margin expansion; XLF +0.07% shows baseline stability with upside on rate support.
Regional bank small-cap exposure: direct beneficiary of higher rates through NIM expansion; -1.53% current drawdown represents capitulation entry point.
Emerging market value: +3.76% YTD, positioning for capital reallocation into undervalued EM equity following developed market leadership rotation.
Small-cap low-volatility value: defensive small-cap exposure with downside protection; -4.55% current loss represents capitulation entry for mean-reversion.

Bitcoin 1x perp instead of 2x: protects prior +45% gains ahead of rate decision volatility. 1x leverage maintains crypto capitulation signal exposure while eliminating liquidation risk on 2% adverse move.
Short TQQQ: tactical short on tech 3x leverage ETF; -8.91% current loss reflects nascent reversal of unsustainable tech momentum; maintains hedge against mega-cap rally.
